mines.mine_notes: Open pit gold mine, Para state; first full year of commercial production. FY2025: 4,086,000 t milled @ 1.44 g/t Au, 90.6% recovery; gold produced 171,871 oz, gold sold 172,093 oz. Nameplate throughput (12,890 tpd) reached July 2025. Total cash cost $748/oz sold; site-level AISC $1,057/oz; AISC $1,155/oz. Average realized gold price $3,374/oz. Franco-Nevada holds a 12.5% gold stream on TZ. SUDAM tax incentive approved Sept 2025 (effective tax rate reduced from 34% to ~15.25% for 10 years from FY2025).

Development project, Region 7. Feasibility Study published Q2 2025 (avg annual production ~155,000 oz). Formal construction decision Oct 1, 2025; initial capital budget $973.0M (committed $423.5M at YE2025; engineering 57% complete). Final Environmental Permit received Sept 2, 2025; Mining License (20-year) granted Dec 8, 2025; pre-production open-pit mining commenced Q1 2026. No production in FY2025.

notes: FY2025 MD&A used (year ended December 31, 2025, dated March 25, 2026). FY2025 revenue $580.7M; free cash flow $254.8M. Year-end 2025 MRMR (disclosed March 12, 2026, NI 43-101): consolidated P&P reserves 6.52 Moz @ 1.60 g/t Au; M&I resources 9.17 Moz; Inferred 1.17 Moz. Gurupi (Brazil) exploration/development project not tabulated as a mine (no reserves disclosed). All amounts in USD.
